ns2:course.label: Honors Seminar III
ns2:course.description: Major British, American, and Anglophone authors. Each seminar considers one or two major authors. May be repeated. Prerequisite: A 3.33 grade-point average or consent of the English Department's Director of Undergraduate Studies. Restricted to English and Rhetoric majors.
